notes: Delta design: run each query with and without the skill loaded. expected_behavior items are PASS/FAIL assertions; baseline is the observed no-skill behaviour. Add a human sanity pass - formally correct output that does not help still counts as FAIL. Record tokens and wall time per run alongside pass/fail. Activation is measured once for the whole family in evals/activation.json.

evals.query: implement user login end to end - specced, built, tested and reviewed
expected_behavior: initializes .sdlc/ with state.json, findings.jsonl and work-log.md
runs the five phases sequentially, each as its own role
does none of the phase work itself
evals.baseline: writes the implementation directly, with no requirements, tests or review

evals.query: the tester found a division-by-zero crash that no requirement covers
expected_behavior: rewinds to analysis - the earliest target_phase among the findings
does not rewind only to implementation
evals.baseline: sends the work straight back to the developer

evals.query: add a null check to parse_config
expected_behavior: declines to start a five-phase run
says the pipeline costs more than the change is worth
evals.baseline: spins up all five agents for a one-line edit

evals.query: TEST_FAILED_DIV_ZERO has come back in three iterations running
expected_behavior: reports that the root cause is mis-routed rather than spending more budget
evals.baseline: keeps iterating until the budget is exhausted

evals.query: we are done - the developer says the code works
expected_behavior: refuses to report success while an unresolved blocker sits in findings.jsonl
requires the tester and reviewer phases to have run
evals.baseline: reports success on the developer's word
